@graph.name: Wart Removal
@graph.description: Visit Derma Solutions for the Best Wart Removal Laser Treatment in Bangalore. Safe, Affordable, and Advanced Laser treatments. Book Your Appointment Today!
@graph.howPerformed: Our dermatologist evaluates the wart's size, type and location to recommend the best option. The area is cleaned, and local anesthesia may be applied for comfort. After removal, a soothing ointment is applied and you'll receive aftercare instructions. Healing typically takes 1–2 weeks, depending on the technique used.

acceptedAnswer.text: Numbing cream or local anesthesia is used, so most patients feel only minimal discomfort.
Most warts are removed in a single session, but stubborn warts may need more than one.

mainEntity.name: Will the wart come back after removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recurrence is possible if the wart isn't fully removed or if you're exposed to HPV again.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to heal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Healing typically takes 1–2 weeks, depending on the technique used.
